about.title: About NatureIndex
about.subtitle: A bilingual window into the living world.
about.mission: NatureIndex makes reliable biodiversity knowledge accessible in both English and Bengali. We believe that people protect what they understand — and that understanding begins in one's own language.
what: Detailed encyclopedia pages for animals, plants, fungi and aquatic life
Taxonomy, physical characteristics, habitat, behaviour and diet
IUCN conservation status, threats and conservation initiatives
Interactive distribution maps and a world biodiversity map
A conservation dashboard with clearly sourced statistics
about.bilingual: Every page, button, chart and map is available in English and Bangladesh Bengali. Switch language at any time — your page, search and filters stay exactly where they were.
about.data: Conservation categories follow the IUCN Red List. Population figures come from official surveys where available. Statistics marked as demonstration data are illustrative and clearly labelled. Photographs are loaded from Wikimedia Commons.
about.privacy: NatureIndex runs entirely in your browser. There are no accounts and no server. Your favorites, notes and preferences are stored only on your device.
about.disclaimer: Information is provided for education. Medicinal uses are described as traditional knowledge and are not medical advice. Never eat wild mushrooms or plants based on an online description.
